more_beautiful.reason: B's forest-green and cream palette, icon tab bar, even rounded cards and large touch-friendly stepper look finished and well made, while A's cool grey background, plain yellow-dot logo and stack of dashed empty boxes look stark, like a wireframe.

less_generic.reason: A's 'stock book' name, its 'Hand out first' heading and its front-desk hints (tins, jars or packs; month-only best-before dates; toiletries; donors who agree to be named), set in a plain public-service style, feel made for this food bank, while B's dark-green header, icon tabs, rounded cards and numbered 'How this works' panel are a familiar AI-app template that any inventory tool could rename.
